questions.title: Travel and transportation 21
questions.statement: Read the situation: An exchange student is using public transportation and must understand directions, schedules, or travel instructions during a trip. What is the best interpretation of the situation described?

options.label: A
options.text: The student should follow the transportation guidance provided.

options.label: B
options.text: The student should ignore all instructions.

options.label: C
options.text: The student must cancel the trip immediately.

options.label: D
options.text: The information is unrelated to transportation.

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A because the scenario focuses on understanding schedules, directions, or transportation procedures. Option B contradicts the purpose of travel guidance. Option C is unsupported because there is no indication the trip must be canceled. Option D is incorrect because the entire situation involves transportation and travel-related communication.
